title: Umusuku w'amababa
intro: Mu bwami burongowe n’umuntu yahawe ububasha ku miyaga, ku biremwa bitaboneka no ku biremwa vyo mw’ijuru, umunyamuryango umwe mutoyi kandi yihuta yarazimiye mu rwego — gusa kugira ngo agaruke afise amahishurirwa yohindura iherezo ry’ihanga ryo kure. Uwo mumenyeshamakuru w’amaso asongoye yarashize ahabona ukuri aho ubujuju bwari bwashinze imizi. Jewe ndi nde?
clues: Nakoze mu rusengero aho abantu, ibiremwa bitaboneka be n’ibiremwa vyo mw’ijuru vyishura umutware umwe w’inkerebutsi yategeka imiyaga nyene.
Naramaze igihe ntariho ku kazi kanje, kandi uburake bw’umutware bwarasezeranywe iyo ntashobora gutanga imvo ihagije.
Ndi ikiremwa gitoyi gihunga, kizwi ko kibona neza, kandi ubwoko bwanje bwarateye iteka mu kwita amazina ataco akora mu mapaji y’ivyahishuriwe.
Maze kugaruka, nazanye inkuru y’igihugu ca kure aho abantu bapfukamira izuba, bahumye Uwaremye ijuru n’isi.
Nasanze umugore atwara ubwami bukomeye, yicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami y’agatangaza, atarigeze amenya ukuri mbere.
Ni jewe navumbuye ubwami bwa Saba’, n’ikete ry’ubutumire ku muhanuzi-umwami yahawe ububasha ku muyaga.

identity.label: Jewe ndi nde?
options: Ikimonyo co mu kiyaya ca Sulaimani
